abstract: Verifies benthic ecological protection permits, cetacean acoustic mitigation protocols, and marine statutory licenses
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENVR). Your responsibilities include verifying benthic ecological protection permits, cetacean acoustic mitigation protocols, and marine statutory licenses for the Celtic Deep subsea cable installation tender.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies benthic ecological protection permits, cetacean acoustic mitigation protocols, and marine statutory licenses（ECOSTAT）
information_points.content:
ENVR-ECOSTAT-XR2：For Cambrian Subsea Installation Group, statutory marine environmental clearance has not been secured, as the proposed installation methodologies across the inter-array cable trenching corridor do not comply with all Special Area of Conservation restrictions under the Natural Resources Wales marine licensing review.
ENVR-ECOSTAT-TGI：For Seaway Oceanic Infrastructure Consortium, statutory marine environmental clearance has been secured, confirming that the proposed installation methodologies across the inter-array cable trenching corridor comply with all Special Area of Conservation restrictions under the Natural Resources Wales marine licensing review.
ENVR-ECOSTAT-FCQ：For Celtic Oceanic Marine Services, statutory marine environmental clearance has been secured, confirming that the proposed installation methodologies across the inter-array cable trenching corridor comply with all Special Area of Conservation restrictions under the Natural Resources Wales marine licensing review.

information_points.title: Subsea hydroacoustic dampening（NOISEMIT）
information_points.content:
ENVR-NOISEMIT-X3X：According to the underwater acoustics mitigation report for Celtic Oceanic Marine Services, the subsea trenching water-jetting spread achieves a hydroacoustic attenuation level of 16 dB using double big-bubble curtain barriers.
ENVR-NOISEMIT-IS2：According to the underwater acoustics mitigation report for Seaway Oceanic Infrastructure Consortium, the subsea trenching water-jetting spread achieves a hydroacoustic attenuation level of 12 dB using double big-bubble curtain barriers.
ENVR-NOISEMIT-298：According to the underwater acoustics mitigation report for Cambrian Subsea Installation Group, the subsea trenching water-jetting spread achieves a hydroacoustic attenuation level of 20 dB using double big-bubble curtain barriers.
